provenance.note: Fresh processes; cold means derived cache empty, not kernel page cache flushed. Synthetic IDs share 32 contents; no PureRef asset access.

preparation.note: Validated historical progress; no frame-path filesystem inventory. 100% ready differs from all settled. Persistence and cancellation may overlap. Derived bytes written means successfully committed PNG volume; attempt bytes are scheduled write sizes, not measured physical I/O. Active time covers observed 128 jobs only; no allocator scratch measurement.
